verses.sanskrit:
नारद उवाच।
              ऋषभस्य ततः शृङ्गं निपत्य द्विजपक्षिणौ। शाण्डिलीं ब्राह्मणीं तत्र ददृशाते तपोन्विताम् ॥१॥
verses.english: Narada said Then having alighted on the peak of the Rishava mountain, the two saw there a Brahmani named Shandili, endued with asceticism.

verses.sanskrit: अभिवाद्य सुपर्णस्तु गालवश्चाभिपूज्य ताम्। तया च स्वागतेनोक्तौ विष्ठरे सन्निषीदतुः ॥२॥
verses.english: Suparna having done her honors, and Galava having worshipped her they were pointed to a seat by her after the usual welcome.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धमन्नं तया दत्तं बलिमन्त्रोपबृंहितम्। भुक्त्वा तृप्तावुभौ भूमौ सुप्तौ तावनुमोहितौ ॥३॥
verses.english: Both, of them, having partaken of the cooked food offered by her after having dedicated the same to the gods with the usual Mantra, were refreshed and both of them slept on the ground and in a moment lost their senses.

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्तात् प्रतिबुद्धस्तु सुपर्णो गमनेप्सया। अथ भ्रष्टतनूजाङ्गमात्मानं ददृशे खगः ॥४॥
verses.english: After a moment Suparna awoke with the desire of departing and the wanderer of the sky saw himself deprived of his wings.

verses.sanskrit: मांसपिण्डोपमोऽभूत्स मुखपादान्वितः खगः। गालवस्तं तथा दृष्ट्वा विमनाः पर्यपृच्छत ॥५॥
verses.english: The ranger of the sky became like a lump of flesh with a mouth and feet and Galava seeing him in that condition asked him with a heavy heart.

verses.sanskrit: किमिदं भवता प्राप्तमिहागमनजं फलम्। वासोऽयमिह कालं तु कियन्तं नौ भविष्यति ॥६॥
verses.english: "What is this condition you find yourself in, as a result of your doing here, for what length of time shall we have to live here.

verses.sanskrit: किं नु ते मनसा ध्यातमशुभं धर्मदूषणम्। न ह्ययं भवतः स्वल्पो व्यभिचारो भविष्यति ॥७॥
verses.english: Is it that in your mind you have entertained a thought which is evil and against the dictates of virtue; this is the result of no small wickedness on your part.

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णोऽथाब्रवीद्विप्रं प्रध्यातं वै मया द्विज। इमां सिद्धामितो नेतुं तत्र यत्र प्रजापतिः ॥८॥
verses.english: Suparna then said to the regenerate one o twice born one, the thought has indeed been entertained by me of carrying away this lady who has been endued with asceticism from this place to where the lord of all creatures is,

verses.sanskrit: यत्र देवो महादेवो यत्र विष्णुः सनातनः। यत्र धर्मश्च यज्ञश्च तत्रेयं निवसेदिति ॥९॥
verses.english: Where resides the lord Mahadeva, where resides the eternal Vishnu and where there are virtue and sacrificial ceremonies, so that she might live there.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽहं भगवतीं याचे प्रणतः प्रियकाम्यया। मयैतन्नाम प्रध्यातं मनसा शोचता किल ॥१०॥
verses.english: I now pray this goddess for my own good with my head bowed down: I have harbored this thought in my mind and have come to grief consequence thereof.

verses.sanskrit: तदेवं बहुमानात्ते मयेहानीप्सितं कृतम्। सुकृतं दुष्कृतं वा त्वं माहात्म्यात् क्षन्तुमर्हसि ॥११॥
verses.english: Out of great respect (for you) did I entertain the thought and whether I did right or wrong, it is fitting that out of your own generosity and noble mindedness you should forgive me. in

verses.sanskrit: सा तौ तदाऽब्रवीत्तुष्टा पतगेन्द्रद्विजर्षभौ। न भेतव्यं सुपर्णोऽसि सुपर्ण त्यज संभ्रमम् ॥१२॥
verses.english: She, thus spoken to, was gratified with the chief of birds and said "Do not fear, O Suparna, become possessed of beautiful wings and leave aside your fears.

verses.sanskrit: निन्दिताऽस्मि त्वया वत्स न च निन्दां क्षमाम्यहम्। लोकेभ्यः सपदि भ्रश्येद्यो मां निन्देत पापकृत् ॥१३॥
verses.english: I have been insulted by your child and I do not forgive insults; that perpetrator of wicked deeds, who would insult me, would quickly be turned out of all regions of bliss.

verses.sanskrit: हीनयाऽलक्षणैः सर्वैस्तथाऽनिन्दितया मया। आचारं प्रतिगृह्णन्त्या सिद्धिः प्राप्तेयमुत्तमा ॥१४॥
verses.english: Devoid as I am of all inauspicious signs, and who am blameless, I have obtained excellent asceticism by following the rules of good conduct.

verses.sanskrit: आचारः फलते धर्ममाचारः फलते धनम्। आचाराच्छ्रियमाप्नोति आचारो हन्त्यलक्षणम् ॥१५॥
verses.english: Good conduct produces virtue, good conduct produces wealth and it is from good conduct that a man attains to prosperity; and good conduct nullifies all inauspicious signs.

verses.sanskrit: तदायुष्मन् खगपते यथेष्टं गम्यतामितः। न च ते गर्हणीयाऽहं गर्हितव्याः स्त्रियः क्वचित् ॥१६॥
verses.english: Do you now, O lord of the rangers of the firinament, go wherever you like; no woman should henceforth be found fault with by you even when she ought to be blamed.

verses.sanskrit: भवितासि यथापूर्वं बलवीर्यसमन्वितः। बभूवतुस्ततस्तस्य पक्षौ द्रविणवत्तरौ ॥१७॥
verses.english: You will be endued with strength and prowess as before;" then did his two wings grow up and they were even stronger than before.

verses.sanskrit: अनुज्ञातस्तु शाण्डिल्या यथागतमुपागमत्। नैव चासाद‌यामास तथारूपांस्तुरङ्गमान् ॥१८॥
verses.english: Being commanded by Shandili he then went away where he wanted to go (with Galava on his back) but did not come across horses of that description.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रोऽथ तं दृष्ट्वा गालवं चाध्वनि स्थितः। उवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठो वैनतेयस्य सन्निधौ ॥१९॥
verses.english: Vishvamitra, while standing on the path, saw Galava and that foremost among speakers said in the presence of the son of Vinata.

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वया स्वयमेवार्थः प्रतिज्ञातो मम द्विज। तस्य कालोऽपवर्गस्य यथा वा मन्यते भवान् ॥२०॥
verses.english: The wealth that you, of your own accord, promised me, O twice-born one, should be given to me; the time to receive the fruit of that promise has come, you can do as you like.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतीक्षिष्याम्यहं कालमेतावन्तं तथा परम्। यथा संसिध्यते विप्र स मार्गस्तु निशम्यताम् ॥२१॥
verses.english: As I have waited all this time, so shall I wait for some time more, and Oregenerate being, look out for that means by which you may be successful.

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णोऽथाब्रवीद्दीनं गालवं भृशदुःखितम्। प्रत्यक्षं खल्विदानीं मे विश्वामित्रो यदुक्तवान् ॥२२॥
verses.english: Suparna then said to Galava who was struck with great sorrow, "What Vishvamitra said to you before, he has repeated in my presence.

verses.sanskrit: तदागच्छ द्विजश्रेष्ठ मन्त्रयिष्याव गालव। नादत्वा गुरवे शक्यं कृत्स्नमर्थं त्वयासितुम् ॥२३॥
verses.english: Therefore do you come, O foremost among the twice-born, we shall consult together ( Galava; without giving to your preceptor the whole of the wealth promised by you, you cannot even sit down."
